==Hero Usage==
* Heroes use this skill with a preference for allies under the effects of a weapon spell, but will use it on any ally if no other skills are available.

== Notes ==
* Be careful when facing a foe with [[Soul Bind]] or [[Scourge Healing]], as the conditional heal is a separate [[packet]], and will make Wielder's Boon trigger these hexes twice.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
